game_title: Safe Get Scout – Blizzard Saddle Trial
game_concept: A puzzle set in Frost Peaks – Blizzard Saddle, a saddle between peaks: the mountaineer must handle crevasse ghouls while practicing strings & dictionaries. Core idea – Safe Get Scout: Use .get() with a default to avoid missing key errors.
theme: Frost Peaks – Blizzard Saddle: a saddle between peaks
core_gameplay_loop: In Blizzard Saddle, repeat each round: Use .get() with a default to avoid missing key errors. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the safe_lookups value and advance.
player_objective: Reach the pass gate using at most 14 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
win_condition: The pass gate reached with actions_used <= 14.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 14 before the pass gate is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 8 – Strings & Dictionaries | Level 8 (extended tier): Safe Get Scout
assets_style: towering pixel-art mountains: glaciers, jagged ice ridges, crisp white and cyan with deep blue shadows; flat Kenney-style sprites; thin howling wind, high strings and ice-crack stings

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how safe_lookups changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against crevasse ghouls in Blizzard Saddle.
